Action_Detail: Export target products from Shopify Admin (Products -> Export) and archive an untouched read-only CSV containing Handle, Option values, SKU, Variant Price, and Variant Compare At Price.
Verification_Method: Confirm CSV row count matches total targeted variants and store backup in a locked folder.

Action_Detail: Flag all SKUs that already have a non-blank Compare-at Price so post-sale rollback restores their original anchor instead of blanking them out.
Verification_Method: Filter backup CSV where Variant Compare At Price > 0 and record exact variant count.

Action_Detail: Test every planned flash sale percentage combined with all active welcome, SMS, VIP, and influencer coupon codes plus payment fees (2.9% + $0.30).
Verification_Method: Run discount_stack_checker.py or getsaleguard.com/tools/discount-stack-checker with zero RED SKUs.

Task_Title: Lock Hard Cost & Minimum Price Floor
Action_Detail: Define minimum allowable selling price per SKU above (Landed Cost + Fixed Fee) / (1 - Fee Rate) to prevent decimal typos ($0.99 disasters).
Verification_Method: Review dry-run preview or spreadsheet floor column for 0 violations.

Task_Title: Disable or Scope Legacy Promo Codes
Action_Detail: Pause automatic discounts or restrict WELCOME/VIP codes from combining with sale collections unless stacked margin stays green.
Verification_Method: Check Shopify Admin -> Discounts -> Active list and confirm combination toggles.

Task_Title: Verify Store Timezone vs Local Timezone
Action_Detail: Confirm scheduled launch and end timestamps match Shopify Admin's Store Timezone (Settings -> General) rather than operator laptop time.
Verification_Method: Cross-check UTC offset in Store Settings and scheduled job summary.

Task_Title: Review EEA / EU Omnibus Compare-At Setting
Action_Detail: If selling into the European Economic Area, verify Settings -> Markets -> Preferences for EEA compare-at visibility and 30-day lowest-price compliance.
Verification_Method: Confirm EEA preference setting and document prior 30-day price history.

Task_Title: Execute Single-SKU Dry Run / Safety Drill
Action_Detail: Test start, storefront strikethrough rendering, cart price, and rollback on 1 low-risk test SKU before touching the full catalog.
Verification_Method: Inspect live test product page in an incognito window and verify exact cent restoration.

Action_Detail: Check collection grids and top 10 bestsellers in an incognito window to verify Compare-at Price > Price across every variant (not only the default size).
Verification_Method: Run getsaleguard.com/tools/store-price-audit or check /products.json for active compare_at_price.

Task_Title: Test Checkout With Old Coupon Codes
Action_Detail: Add a discounted bestseller to cart and attempt to apply legacy WELCOME10 / VIP15 codes to verify stacking rules behave as intended.
Verification_Method: Capture test checkout screenshot confirming expected subtotal before canceling.

Task_Title: Log Any Mid-Sale Manual Price Edits
Action_Detail: Record any SKU whose price was manually adjusted mid-campaign (due to supplier cost shifts or inventory moves) so rollback does not silently overwrite it.
Verification_Method: Maintain a mid-sale exception list or enable external-edit protection in scheduler.

Task_Title: Trigger Scheduled Auto-Revert or Trimmed CSV Restore
Action_Detail: Revert sale prices to exact pre-sale (price, compare_at_price) pairs without overwriting product descriptions, tags, or inventory edited during the sale.
Verification_Method: Confirm job completion status or trimmed CSV import email with 0 errors.

Task_Title: Verify Zero Stuck Sale Variants Publicly
Action_Detail: Audit live catalog to confirm 100% of targeted variants reverted and zero items remain stuck at BFCM prices during morning traffic.
Verification_Method: Run public /products.json check via getsaleguard.com/tools/store-price-audit showing 0 stuck variants.

Action_Detail: Turn back on any paused evergreen welcome popups or abandoned-cart coupon codes once full retail prices are verified live.
Verification_Method: Check Klaviyo/Shopify Discounts status and test one evergreen code in cart.

Task_Title: Archive Post-Sale Audit Receipt & Margin Report
Action_Detail: Save final rollback verification log, compare actual gross margin against forecast, and update floor guardrails for the next promotion.
Verification_Method: Store audit receipt alongside backup CSV in campaign folder.
